## Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
The fix adds a "Plan B": when the branch lookup fails, find the merge request and use its pipeline instead. This is exactly the same pattern that MR !1419 used for the `glab ci get` command.

The beauty of this fix is that it's **backward compatible** - it still works for regular branch pipelines, but now also handles MR pipelines when needed.
